algorithms.name: RSA
algorithms.description: Integer factorization cryptography; completely solvable in polynomial time via Shor's Algorithm.

algorithms.name: ECDSA
algorithms.description: Elliptic curve digital signatures; discrete logarithm solved in polynomial time by Shor's Algorithm.

algorithms.name: Diffie-Hellman
algorithms.description: Finite-field key agreement; discrete logarithm broken by Shor's Algorithm (enables retrospective decryption).

algorithms.name: ECDH
algorithms.description: Elliptic curve key agreement; session keys recoverable with CRQC.

algorithms.name: DSA
algorithms.description: Digital Signature Algorithm; broken by Shor's Algorithm and legacy parameter weaknesses.

algorithms.name: Ed25519
algorithms.description: Edwards-curve signature scheme; broken by Shor's Algorithm on quantum hardware.

algorithms.name: X25519
algorithms.description: Montgomery curve key exchange; requires hybrid PQC encapsulation (ML-KEM-768).

algorithms.name: MD5
algorithms.description: Classically broken hashing function; collision attacks demonstrated in seconds. Insecure today.

algorithms.name: SHA-1
algorithms.description: Classically broken digest with practical chosen-prefix collision attacks. Banned by NIST.

algorithms.name: DES
algorithms.description: 56-bit block cipher vulnerable to brute-force in hours. Completely broken.

algorithms.name: 3DES
algorithms.description: 64-bit block size susceptible to Sweet32 birthday collision attacks. Deprecated by NIST in 2023.

algorithms.name: RC4
algorithms.description: Stream cipher with multiple keystream biases. Banned in TLS RFC 7465.

algorithms.name: AES-128
algorithms.description: Grover's Algorithm quadratic speedup reduces effective security from 128 to ~64 bits. Upgrade to AES-256 recommended.

algorithms.name: AES-256
algorithms.description: Maintains ~128 bits of effective security against Grover's quantum search. Post-quantum approved.

algorithms.name: ChaCha20-Poly1305
algorithms.description: 256-bit stream cipher with Poly1305 authenticator; robust against quantum search.

algorithms.name: SHA-256
algorithms.description: Grover collision search reduces bit margin to ~128 bits. Use SHA-384 or SHA-512 for high assurance.

algorithms.name: SHA-384
algorithms.description: High-margin hash function providing 192 bits of post-quantum collision resistance (CNSA 2.0 standard).

algorithms.name: SHA-512
algorithms.description: 256 bits of quantum collision resistance against Brassard-Høyer-Tapp algorithm.

algorithms.name: TLS 1.0
algorithms.description: Deprecated protocols with BEAST, POODLE, and weak key-exchange vulnerabilities.

algorithms.name: TLS 1.2
algorithms.description: Classical handshake relying on RSA/ECDH key agreement; migrate to TLS 1.3 with Hybrid PQC.

algorithms.name: TLS 1.3
algorithms.description: Supports hybrid post-quantum key encapsulation (e.g., X25519+ML-KEM-768).
